title: A toy reaction-transport signalling model reports synthetic network gains
status_authority: Exact selected source bytes and scoped source reports are preserved. This incremental integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority, or practical advantage.
reported_status: The XH2 continuation describes an abstract reaction-diffusion/signalling model and synthetic finite-network comparisons. It is a mathematical toy model only; no biological implementation, measured cells, tissue-scale cost, or validated global optimizer is supplied.
scientific_scope_status: The source compares role-labelled signalling and transport choices in synthetic networks. It reports finite-model performance changes and corrections when the direction of transport is reversed; a naive same-direction signal loses much of the modelled improvement. These are computations on synthetic instances, not biological measurements, intervention recipes, or evidence of a working tissue system.
